title: wallpaper can show through a bottom panel while it de-floats and re-floats, which is very obvious with a dark panel and a light wallpaper Edit: permanently visible, not just when fading in and out.
line: When a floating panel de-floats or re-floats, a thin line of wallpaper no longer shows between it and a maximized window.
explanation: PanelView gives KWin the panel's blur/contrast region from the QML panelMask, shifted by floatingTranslucentItemOffset, but only recomputed it when panelMask changed, i.e. when the background changed size. During the floating animation a bottom (or right) panel's background mostly moves rather than resizes, so the blur region stayed a pixel or two behind it; KWin then drew a blurred-wallpaper strip in the part of the region the background had left, which shows as a light line between a dark panel and a maximized window. The panel now also updates the region whenever the background's offset changes, so it moves with the background on every animation step.

commits.message:
shell/panelview: move the blur region along with a de-floating panel

The blur region only followed the panel background's size, so while the
panel de-floated or re-floated it lagged behind the moving background,
showing a strip of wallpaper. Also update it when the background moves.

BUG: 511379

media.caption: Master, mid de-float after maximizing a window (animations slowed 8x, white wallpaper, Breeze Dark): a light line runs along the panel's top edge
Same moment with the fix: the window meets the panel with no line
Master: maximize a window, the panel de-floats with a wallpaper line above it the whole way, then unmaximize
With the fix: same steps, no line during de-float or re-float
